customer_access.instructions: Unzip the package archive and follow README.md instructions.

prerequisites: Modern Web Browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
Microsoft Excel 2016+ or compatible spreadsheet software (Google Sheets, LibreOffice Calc)
steps: Download and extract the ZIP archive to your local machine.
Review the executive playbook PDF in deliverables/
Populate your team assumptions into the companion spreadsheet model.
installation_guide.troubleshooting: If fonts do not display correctly in PDF, ensure your PDF reader has system font rendering enabled.
